note: Method and path of every documented operation, and the parameters GitHub marks x-multi-segment. Used only to test how Fabric routes requests; no descriptions or schemas are kept.
reviewedNote: Not from GitHub's description: Fabric's own review, read from GitHub's prose. GitHub says a ref is written as heads/<branch name> or tags/<tag name>, which spans segments, but marks none of these parameters x-multi-segment. Each entry is a documented route and the parameter Fabric reads as multi-segment. branches/{branch} is not listed: a slashed branch would pull branch protection reads into a reviewed row. This note and reviewedMultiSegment are left out of the proxy settings hash: the routing they allow is bound through the {+ref} templates in catalog/permissions/github.json.
